Council approves budget for road repairs

The council voted seven to two on Tuesday to spend four million on road repairs next year, most of it on the ring road and the streets around the station.

The money comes from a reserve that was set aside after last winter, when frost damage closed two lanes of the ring road for most of February and March.

Work is due to start in April and finish before the autumn, the council said. Residents can see the full list of streets on the council website from next week.
